purpose: Single-pair source-condition, measurement and independent-reference feasibility; not a benchmark freeze
selection_gates: At least one explicit condition-to-action relation
Relevant antecedents can be asked directly under a separate protocol
selection_failure: If none qualifies, PAIR_NOT_ADMITTED; do not collect labels or replace the pair after ratings
pair_use: Independent review of a conditional-relevance hypothesis only; source does not certify an ordering
goal: I want to choose which of these two general sleep-education resources to read first to understand my current situation and possible next steps. Judge relative information relevance, allowing ties or unknown; do not infer a diagnosis, treatment benefit or a need to stop reading either resource.
real_cases: All 12 Day 4 selected real windows, unchanged; new self-report variables are NOT_COLLECTED, never inferred from wearable aggregates
existing_probe_context: Only frozen sleep_duration mean at 14 days is in the Day 5 permitted wearable context; fixed before labels, descriptive only. Reference sees the full Day 5 permitted context, not an arm-specific subset.
historical_alignment: No newly collected present-day answer can backfill a 2024/2025 window. Primary records must have reference interval and reported_at no later than the observation cutoff. Retrospective recall is separate and not primary.
synthetic_mechanism: Six explicitly fictional contexts: 2x2 often-sleep-trouble YES/NO by late-day-caffeine YES/NO plus two UNKNOWN variants. Other selected symptom cues held NO. No expected preference or synthetic qrel is generated.

independent_review.gap_scope: Research repeat-memory control only, not a clinical threshold
independent_review.blindness: Opaque per-rater/per-session IDs and order; hide old labels, rankers, expected directions, condition truth tables, paired-case mappings and the other reviewer
independent_review.origin_disclosure: REAL versus SYNTHETIC is always visible; no fabricated real histories
independent_review.within_rater_stability: All three canonical preferences must match; no majority repair
independent_review.between_rater_agreement: Both actual reviewers must be stable and agree. Stable disagreements require a third distinct human adjudicator; adjudication cannot repair within-rater instability.
independent_review.source_review: Both reviewers separately check the complete source units before an accepted reference; model source audit is not human verification
independent_review.minimum_real_reference: At least four primary real contexts from at least two actual participants with collected contextual evidence; ties/unknown count as reviewed outcomes but do not create strict utility labels

hard_applicability: No verified unit-level necessary/exclusion gate; selected source action cues are not unit-level applicability or an automatic priority rule

mechanism.D: Acquire SR5-late-day-caffeine, one behavior self-report question; active source-related control, not assumed irrelevant
mechanism.initial_context: Same known initial source-context evidence in both arms
mechanism.cost_unit: answered question count, including UNKNOWN; latency unmeasured, not medical test cost
mechanism.ranking_rule_reason: No source-condition-to-priority rule is admitted. Source-cue propagation is diagnosed; no priority scores are manufactured.
mechanism.utility_gate: Collected real context plus stable independent source-checked shared reference plus a separately preregistered ranker; otherwise all ranking utility remains null
